apps.name: LingoMage
apps.author: Javier Melo
apps.summary: AI-powered stories tailored to your interests and reading level.
apps.description: Learn languages with interactive AI-generated stories tailored to your interests and reading level, with vocabulary notes, audio playback, and progress tracking.

apps.name: Working Hours
apps.author: Javier Melo
apps.summary: Track shifts, breaks, and overtime with end-of-day reminders.
apps.description: Track daily working hours, breaks, and overtime balance on your phone. Works completely offline with optional end-of-day reminder notifications.

apps.name: B-log
apps.author: Javier Melo
apps.summary: Log boulders by tapping walls on your gym map and track progress.
apps.description: An offline boulder logbook for indoor climbing. Load a built-in gym or upload a layout file, tap a wall to log flashes, sends, and tries by difficulty and hold color, and track your progress over weeks and months.

apps.name: Starter Demo
apps.author: App²
apps.summary: A sample app for exploring storage, photos, speech, and AI in App².
apps.description: An interactive starter demo included in App². Try local file storage, photo selection, reminders, speech, and AI, or edit its HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build your own subapp.
